_readme: S638 worker for SkyTamarind, 2026-11-11. De Anza's 2025-2026 records failed the degree check 71 times as 'incomplete' against the 90-quarter-unit degree: the record names the degree total and a GE pattern (De Anza GE 53, Cal-GETC 14, CSU GE 4) with no units for the pattern. The extraction on the 2026-2027 eLumen catalog (run 43056325121) is expected to carry the same gap. COBIx reports Local GE 29-41 quarter units and Cal-GETC 45-58 (handoff 637, unverified). This read asks De Anza's own pages for those figures, so a ge_units step rests on the college's words: two degree pages (a local A.A. and an A.A.-T), the Cal-GETC page, and the articulation GE page on daweb2 (www.deanza.edu answers the reader 403; blocked_sources). No model call.

questions.ge_units: What does De Anza print for the units of its local GE pattern (AA/AS) and of Cal-GETC, in quarter units?
questions.degree_words: How does a 2026-2027 degree page word its total and its GE requirement (90 units, GE pattern, electives as needed)?

outside_hosts.elumenapp.com: De Anza College's own 2026-2027 catalog (deanza.elumenapp.com), served on its catalog vendor's domain, with the vendor's API its pages call (api-prod.elumenapp.com)
